title: Command item
brief: A selected row from a command palette: icon tile, title, helper line and keyboard shortcut caps, on a layered soft shadow.

inspiration.note: Took the row with a leading icon and trailing shortcut keys; the layered shadow, keycap bevel and accent bar on hover are our own.
Took the idea of a bevelled keycap with a thicker bottom edge; sizes and mono type are ours.
